content.name: p
children: Delegated administration and desired-state reconciliation also answer different questions. When the team lead grants

to Dana in PostgreSQL, the access is real immediately—but if that edge is absent from policy, the next authoritative pgroles plan treats it as drift. Durable delegation needs a workflow that writes the approved membership back to policy.

content.name: p

removes only the edge attributed to the revoker: revoking the team lead's grant as anyone else succeeds with just a
and leaves Dana's membership in place, unless the revoke runs
the team lead with that role's privileges. pgroles revokes each edge
its recorded grantor, so reconciling the delegation away works — and the plan preflight names any grantor whose privileges the executor lacks.
